name: zero_cost_loop
description: boss-ai A27: a 0-cost spell that gives the boss's 0/1 +1 health and returns a copy of itself to hand. It always beats end_turn on f_board and never runs out, so only max_actions_per_turn stops the turn. No attacker, no burn: the lethal search prunes at the root. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
